# Yulia — Professional Live-In House & Pet Sitting

> Professional live-in house and pet sitting for nightly, weekly, and extended stays. Tailored care for vacations, relocations, remote work, and pets requiring full-time company, structured routines, and attentive care.

## Core Sitter Profile
- **Sitter Name**: Yulia Savinkova
- **Profession**: Professional House & Pet Sitter & Software Engineer
- **Presence Model**: Live-in, full-time work-from-home (no long daytime absences)
- **Base Location**: California, United States (Open to nationwide sits for selected opportunities)
- **Direct Website**: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/
- **TrustedHousesitters Profile**: https://www.trustedhousesitters.com/house-and-pet-sitters/united-states/california/san-francisco/l/6526245/
- **Background Verification**: Clean background check, 5-star verified homeowner reviews
- **Direct Contact / Inquiries**: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/#booking-form-section

## Services Included
1. **Full-Time Live-In Pet Care**:
   - Feeding, fresh water, medication administration (oral, topical, scheduled routines).
   - Daily exercise, walks, enrichment, and constant companionship.
   - Brushing, coat care, and strict adherence to owner house rules.
   - Frequent photo and video updates sent to homeowners.
2. **Home & Property Stewardship**:
   - Home security presence (lived-in, active home deterrent).
   - Plant and garden watering routines (indoor houseplants, patio, yard).
   - Mail and package collection, trash/recycling bin management.
   - Managing scheduled home maintenance visits and emergency coordination.
3. **Specialized Care Capabilities**:
   - Senior pet mobility support and medication adherence.
   - High-energy and reactive dog handling.
   - Shy or anxious rescue pet care.
   - Plants-only and empty property care (no pets required).

## Rates & Pricing Model
- **1 Month (30 Days)**: $999 base (~$33.30/day)
- **1 Week (7 Days)**: $299 base (~$42.71/day)
- **1 Night**: $99 base
- **Extended Stays (60+ Days / 2+ Months)**: 10% discount on entire booking
- **Custom Add-Ons**:
  - High-energy / reactive dogs: +$15/day
  - Complex medical needs / medication: +$15/day
  - Garden management / sensitive landscaping: +$10/day
- **Currency**: USD

## Coverage Areas & Locations
- **California**: San Francisco Bay Area, Santa Barbara, Malibu, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Los Angeles, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna Beach, Carlsbad, La Jolla, San Diego, and broader California regions.
- **Nationwide**: Open to sits anywhere across the United States for selected long-term and monthly opportunities. Distance is no barrier for extended stays.

## Booking & Consultation Workflow
1. Homeowner submits trip dates and pet details via the inquiry form: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/#booking-form-section
2. Introductory video call to align on routines, home care requirements, and expectations.
3. Written agreement and mutual commitment confirmation.
